summary: The Playwright test is syntactically correct and uses the API properly, ensuring that the product detail page loads and a product name is visible. However, the navigation validation regex is weak as it broadly matches any URL containing 'product', which may lead to false positives, and the selectors use data-test attributes which seem specific but there is no testCaseId link in the test title. The test lacks coverage for other product details and more robust assertion of page content.

issues.description: The URL assertion uses a weak regex (/product/), which may allow matching unintended URLs. The selector '[data-test="product-1"]' may be fragile if data attribute changes.
issues.recommendation: Use a more specific URL validation or include product ID queries to ensure the correct page loads. Confirm stability of data-test attributes.

issues.description: The test title does not mention the associated testCaseId (TC-001).
issues.recommendation: Include the testCaseId in the test name for traceability and maintenance.

issues.description: The test only checks page URL and visibility of product name but does not verify other product details.
issues.recommendation: Add assertions for other product information elements to improve test coverage.

recommendations: Enhance URL validation to uniquely identify the product detail page.
Incorporate the testCaseId in the test title.
Add more detailed assertions for product details if evidence allows.
